answer_1.quote: S-VCO rewards the model for attending to matching images and strongly rejecting contradictory images with incorrect details.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include image captions and conversational responses to visual queries, with an emphasis on aligning textual details to minimal visual contrasts in images.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the models on a wide range of benchmarks spanning various ability domains... General: LLaVABench, MMVet; Hallucination: MM-Hal; Vision-Centric: CVBench, MMVP; OCR: TextVQA; Knowledge: SQA.

answer_3.quote: As the evaluation judge, we use gpt-4-0613 for LLaVABench and MMVet, and gpt-4-turbo for MM-Hal.
